subject.title: [Feature]: `openclaw plugins init --type channel` scaffold for channel plugin development

question: Should OpenClaw own and version a channel-plugin scaffold in the public `plugins init` CLI, or should channel starters remain an external/plugin-authoring resource built on the existing SDK?
rationale: This adds a durable public CLI workflow and a generated package contract across channel setup, manifests, configuration, lifecycle, and validation; repository policy requires an explicit core-versus-plugin ownership decision before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor a minimal core scaffold
options.body: Define a small supported channel-plugin starter based only on public SDK barrels, add generator validation, and commit to keeping it aligned with channel SDK changes.

options.title: Publish an external starter instead
options.body: Keep the core CLI limited to existing scaffold types and provide a versioned plugin or template package with install, update, and smoke-proof guidance.

options.title: Improve docs first
options.body: Expand the channel-plugin guide with an audited minimal example before committing to a generated public contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a minimal core scaffold
recommendation.body: Define a small supported channel-plugin starter based only on public SDK barrels, add generator validation, and commit to keeping it aligned with channel SDK changes.
